name: PayPal CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a worldwide technology platform for digital payments among businesses and consumers, offered under brands like PayPal, Venmo, Braintree, Xoom, Zettle, Hyperwallet, Honey and Paidy. Users can move money in roughly 200 markets and 100 currencies, cash out in 56 currencies and keep balances in 25.
